verdict.rationale: Polar documents an official remote MCP server that lets AI agents look up data and take actions across products, customers, subscriptions, orders and benefits. It uses OAuth and has documented setup for Cursor, Claude Code, ChatGPT and Claude Desktop, so users can operate their Polar organization through natural-language prompts in those clients. The natural-language layer comes from third-party agent clients rather than a built-in assistant. missing for 10: a native in-dashboard natural-language assistant, detailed documentation of which actions and tools the MCP server exposes, and independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works in practice.
